jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer, Agentic Platform
jobs.jd: We are looking for a product-minded AI engineer to turn what our customers are trying to decide into agents they actually rely on. AskWaive, our in-product assistant, is already live; the work now is quality, coverage, and an experience that wows. This is not a role for a prompt author or a demo builder. We want an owner: someone who takes a customer need—already expressed through our serving layers and semantic layer—and turns it into an endpoint, a tool, and an experience that makes the customer measurably better at their job. Agent engineering, deployment, and testing are all part of delivery, not a handoff. Our core data platform is owned by the team that built it. You'll build on top of it—and where data or infrastructure is holding an agent back, you'll have the standing to propose the change and drive it. What You'll Do From Customer Need to Product Superpower Own the Outcome: Start from the customer, and stay with it until the agent is answering their needs better Build Agents and Tools: Build production agents and the tools they call—retrieval, multi-step workflows, action-taking—on Amazon Bedrock, with Bedrock AgentCore as our runtime and tools exposed over MCP (Model Context Protocol). Turn Serving Layers Into Capability: Our semantic layer and service APIs are where customer needs are already expressed. Your job is turning them into endpoints and tools an agent can wield well—and knowing which metrics and entities it should reach at all. Shape the Experience, Not Just the Endpoint: How an answer arrives—its speed, its confidence, its explanation, the next step it offers—is the product. A technically correct response a customer ignores is a failure. Prove It and Make It Felt Measure Groundedness: Build the eval harness—labeled test sets, groundedness and hallucination rates you can put a number on, and CI gates that stop a regression before it ships. Measure What Customers Got: Adoption, feedback, intent—then report realized impact back to Product and the business in numbers that hold up. Diagnose and Iterate: Instrument the tracing that shows why an answer was wrong, turn each failure mode into a specific fix, and ship again. This loop is the job, not a phase of it. Deliver Ship and Operate: Own the serving path—MCP endpoints, latency, cost per response, caching, and runtime guardrails. Deployment and testing are part of the job, not a handoff. Embed and Influence: Partner with Product Managers and engineers on which decisions an agent should support—and which it shouldn't. Where data or infrastructure limits what an agent can do, drive the change alongside the team that owns the platform. Who You Are The Owner: You measure your work by whether customers made better decisions with the agent's help, not by whether it shipped. The Agent Builder: You've taken an agent past the demo. You know the hard part is everything after it works once—coverage, grounding, cost, and the failure modes you only see at scale. You fix problems without waiting for a ticket. The Experience Obsessive: You care how an answer lands, not just whether it was right. Trustworthy, fast, and legible beats clever. We know that great talent comes from many backgrounds. If you are a builder who cares about the "why" behind the code, we want to hear from you! HOW WE WORK We build with coding agents. You set direction and targets, review output critically, and build the harnesses—scaffolding, context, tests, review loops—that make the next task faster for the whole team. The leverage is in the verification: the tests, CI gates, and typed interfaces that make agent-written code safe to merge. What You"ll Bring Experience: 5+ years building production software or data-intensive systems used by real customers, with strong Python skills—including at least one LLM or agent feature you shipped to production users. AWS & Agent Stack: Hands-on AWS experience, ideally Amazon Bedrock and Bedrock AgentCore. Equivalent agent runtimes transfer, but we build on AWS and you'll be productive faster if you have prior exposure. Agent Engineering: Orchestration, tool and function design, context assembly, and multi-step workflows—you've made the design calls, not just the prompt calls. Retrieval & Domain Grounding: You've built retrieval over real business data, you can explain how context gets selected and why an answer was wrong, and you have enough SQL and metric fluency to catch an agent answering with the wrong number. Evaluation & Iteration: You've built or owned an eval loop for a generative system—labelled sets, regression gates, and a number you could defend when someone asked whether it got better. Product Sense for AI: You have opinions about how an agent should behave—when to answer, when to ask, when to refuse, how to show its work—and you've shipped those opinions, not just argued them. Measurement & Narrative: You've quantified what an agent actually delivered for users—adoption, task success, decision quality—and presented it to people who were never going to read your traces. Working With Agents: You've used coding agents on real production work, you can tell correct output from merely plausible output, and you invest in the harnesses that make the next task faster. Communication & Collaboratio n: Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a track record of working across technical and non-technical teams. Bonus Points For: LLM observability tooling (Langfuse, LangSmith, or Arize). Semantic layer or metrics-layer design (Ossie, dbt). Field-service, logistics, or other operational SaaS domains. Prior experience as a senior or lead engineer responsible for guiding technical direction. Location: Remote (UK-based) with occasional collaborative team meetups. Right to Work: Applicants must currently have the legal right to work in the UK. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position at this time. Compensation Additional Information WHAT YOU SHOULD KNOW ABOUT US Laid back but focused: We offer

jobs.title: Data Scientist, Enterprise Analytics
jobs.jd: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab . An Overview of this role As a Data Scientist at GitLab on the Enterprise Analytics team, you’ll be a trusted analytical partner to Sales, Revenue Operations, and Finance, helping define how we measure go-to-market performance and where we invest to grow. This is a strategic and hands-on role. You’ll apply statistical, experimentation, and machine learning methods to forecast outcomes, explain what drives activation, conversion, expansion, and retention, and size opportunities. You’ll also support the company-level reporting and GTM performance views that executives use to run the business, covering consumption, ARR, and first orders. What you’ll do Embed yourself with business teams to become a trusted partner supporting insight generation and strategic decision making across GTM. Perform exploratory data analysis to uncover behavioral trends, long-term patterns, and the key drivers and levers behind business performance, and communicate their impact clearly to non-technical audiences. Build and productionize machine learning models - such as propensity, product-qualified lead (PQL) scoring, churn, and expansion models - including training, validation, testing, and feature engineering, using MLOps practices and tooling (CI/CD for ML pipelines, model registries, automated retraining, and monitoring) to move work reliably from notebook to production Design, run, and evaluate growth experiments (A/B tests and quasi-experiments) on onboarding, pricing and packaging, and upgrade flows, and measure their impact on activation, conversion, and retention Build and operationalize agentic workflows for analysis, modeling, and pipeline automation, with evaluation and monitoring that keep agent-generated insights accurate, traceable, and trustworthy. Contribute to GitLab ’s Semantic Layer enabling stakeholders and agents to self-serve metrics using trusts and tested sources. Write production-grade Python and SQL that meets internal standards for style, maintainability, and performance in a high-scale database environment; maintain and advocate for these standards through code review What you’ll bring 3-5 years of professional experience in GTM analytics, data science, or a similar technical role Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business problems into clear, measurable questions and communicate technical concepts effectively to non-technical stakeholders. Experience with experimentation and causal inference (A/B testing, power analysis, quasi-experimental methods) and with statistical and machine learning methods such as regression, classification, clustering, and survival analysis Deep, hands-on understanding of SQL in cloud data warehouses (like Snowflake SQL), including working with product usage and event data, and in business intelligence tools (Looker, Tableau, Hex, or similar) Experience using Python for statistical modeling, machine learning, and production data science. With hands-on experience in pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, Jupyter, and related libraries such as LightGBM and XGBoost Hands-on experience building agentic workflows with AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, OpenCode, or similar), including connecting agents to the right context, tools, and platforms such as MLflow, and evaluating their output for accuracy and reliability. Experience working in a B2C company working with motions and metrics, including Consumption, CRR, ARR, and Churn & Contraction Self-motivated and self-managing, with strong organizational skills Ability to use GitLab and to thrive in a fully remote organization About the Team The Enterprise Analytics team builds the trusted data products and insights behind GitLab ’s Company wide sales, revenue, and finance reporting. We work across the business on metrics including First Orders, pipeline, CRR, ARR, and other key indicators, helping leaders make informed decisions and teams understand how their work contributes to GitLab ’s growth. The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary. United States Salary Range $86,400—$176,400

jobs.jd: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role We're building agents that run real parts of our business, take on real work, and get better based on the results they produce. You'll build them with whatever is most capable right now: our own agents platform, the latest orchestration tools, and frontier models. The hard part is making them reliable, measurable, and safe enough for the business to depend on. You'll sit in Marketing Engineering and be forward-deployed to our growth pods, where you'll find the problems worth solving and own the solutions end to end. You might be a forward-deployed builder, an applied AI engineer who has taken agents beyond the demo stage, or a full-stack engineer who is curious about growth. Requirements Python, SQL, LLM APIs and agent orchestration You've shipped production systems that other people relied on, starting from a vague problem You've built with LLMs beyond a demo and know how to evaluate them and where they fail You measure whether what you built worked Bonus: experience with GTM data or marketing systems. Location This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe, with the ability to operate in GMT and GMT+1 timezones. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London and Warsaw. #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.title: Lead Data Scientist H/F
jobs.jd: Volta Medical is an innovative, data-inspired US and European-based growth MedTech aimed at creating and bringing to the market cutting-edge AI software products to revolutionize interventional cardiac electrophysiology. Volta has created a data collection and enrichment ecosystem for curated EP lab data which is fed into a physician validated, machine learning methodology to support complex AF solutions. Our newest technology, Volta AF-Xplorer II, is a data-driven AI decision support system that easily integrates into the standard physician workflow, providing a patient-tailored approach to complex AF and AT procedures. Our dynamic, innovative team is made up of 100+ collaborators in the EU and USA from a wide variety of backgrounds including engineers, business professionals and physicians, working together to develop AI solutions that help electrophysiologists help patients. Mission As Lead Data Science, you will play a key role in shaping the future of Volta's AI technology. You will lead a multidisciplinary Data Science team and contribute directly to the development of innovative machine learning solutions embedded in medical devices used daily in electrophysiology labs worldwide. Reporting to the VP Innovation, you will combine scientific expertise, technical leadership and people management to drive the development of next-generation AI algorithms while ensuring compliance with medical device quality and regulatory standards. Your Responsibilities Technical Leadership Define and drive the Data Science roadmap in alignment with product and business priorities. Lead the design, development and validation of state-of-the-art Machine Learning and Deep Learning algorithms. Ensure scientific excellence and promote best practices in AI research and development. Stay up to date with the latest advances in AI and identify opportunities to integrate new technologies into Volta's products. Support the definition of data strategies and contribute to the continuous improvement of data collection pipelines. Team Leadership Lead, mentor and grow a team of Data Scientists, Data Engineers and PhD researchers. Foster a collaborative, innovative and high-performance culture. Coach team members in both technical and professional development. Coordinate priorities, allocate resources and ensure timely project delivery. Product Development Collaborate closely with Software Engineering, Clinical, Regulatory and Product teams throughout the product lifecycle. Contribute to software architecture discussions involving AI components. Ensure production-ready, maintainable and high-quality code. Participate in the preparation of technical documentation required for regulatory submissions. Scientific & External Collaboration Represent Volta Medical at scientific conferences and technical events. Contribute to publications, patents and collaborations with academic partners. Communicate AI strategy and technical achievements to executive leadership, partners and investors. Your Profile Education & Experience PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Physics or a related field. 10+ years of experience developing Machine Learning solutions in an industrial R&D environment. 5+ years of experience leading technical teams or mentoring Data Scientists. Experience working in regulated environments (Medical Devices, Healthcare, Automotive, Aerospace or similar) is a strong plus. Experience bringing AI models from research to production. Technical Skills Strong expertise in Machine Learning, Deep Learning and statistical modeling. Excellent understanding of model development, evaluation and deployment. Strong programming skills in Python. Experience with PyTorch, Scikit-learn, NumPy, Pandas and related ML libraries. Familiarity with software engineering best practices (Git, testing, CI/CD, Docker). Good knowledge of Linux environments. Experience with cloud computing and MLOps is a plus. Signal processing knowledge would be highly appreciated. Soft Skills Strong leadership and coaching abilities. Excellent communication and presentation skills. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities. Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary and international environment. Fluent English (spoken and written). Why join Volta Medical? Artificial Intelligence is transforming healthcare, and Volta Medical is at the forefront of this revolution. Joining us means contributing to cutting-edge medical technologies that directly improve patients' lives while working alongside internationally recognized experts in electrophysiology, AI and medical devices. At Volta, you will enjoy: Meaningful work with real clinical impact. An international, multidisciplinary and collaborative environment. The opportunity to work on state-of-the-art AI applied to healthcare. High autonomy and opportunities for professional growth. Regular scientific exchanges and innovation-driven culture. A workplace located in Marseille, offering an exceptional Mediterranean lifestyle. Volta Medical is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We encourage qualified individuals from all backgrounds to apply. If you are passionate about leveraging technology to make a positive impact on healthcare, we'd love to hear from you! Recruitment Process Introductory & Culture Fit interview with our Senior VP People (45 min) Technical & Leadership interview with our VP Innovation and our CTO (90min) Interview with our CEO (60 min) Coffee chat at our Marseille HQ (120 min) Spend time with the Data Science team, our Chief Clinical & Regulatory Officer, and our Co-founders (Julien/Clément). jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Applications and Compiler Engineer, LPX
jobs.jd: We are now looking for a Senior Machine Learning Applications and Compiler Engineer! NVIDIA is seeking engineers to develop algorithms and optimizations for our LPX inference and compiler stack. You will work at the intersection of large-scale systems, compilers, and deep learning, crafting how neural network workloads map onto future NVIDIA platforms. This is your chance to be part of something outstandingly innovative! What you’ll be doing: Build, develop, and maintain high-performance runtime and compiler components, focusing on end-to-end inference optimization. Define and implement mappings of large-scale inference workloads onto NVIDIA ’s systems. Extend and integrate with NVIDIA ’s SW ecosystem, contributing to libraries, tooling, and interfaces that enable seamless deployment of models across platforms. Benchmark, profile, and monitor key performance and efficiency metrics to ensure the compiler generates efficient mappings of neural network graphs to our inference hardware. Collaborate closely with hardware architects and design teams to feedback software observations, influence future architectures, and codesign features that unlock new performance and efficiency points. Prototype and evaluate new compilation and runtime techniques, including graph transformations, scheduling strategies, and memory/layout optimizations tailored to spatial processors. Publish and present technical work on novel compilation approaches for inference and related spatial accelerators at top tier ML, compiler, and computer architecture venues. What we need to see: MS or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience, with 5 years of relevant experience. Strong software engineering background with proficiency in systems level programming (e.g., C/C++ and/or Rust) and solid CS fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and concurrency. Hands on experience with compiler or runtime development, including IR design, optimization passes, or code generation. Experience with LLVM and/or MLIR, including building custom passes, dialects, or integrations. Familiarity with deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow and PyTorch, and experience working with portable graph formats such as ONNX. Solid understanding of parallel and heterogeneous compute architectures, such as GPUs, spatial accelerators, or other domain specific processors. Strong analytical and debugging skills, with experience using profiling, tracing, and benchmarking tools to drive performance improvements. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across hardware, systems, and software teams. Ideal candidates will have direct experience with MLIR based compilers or other multilevel IR stacks, especially in the context of graph based deep learning workloads. Ways to stand out from the crowd: Prior work on spatial or dataflow architectures, including static scheduling, pipeline parallelism, or tensor parallelism at scale. Contributions to opensource ML frameworks, compilers, or runtime systems, particularly in areas related to performance or scalability. Demonstrated research impact, such as publications or presentations at conferences like PLDI, CGO, ASPLOS, ISCA, MICRO, MLSys, NeurIPS, or similar. Experience with large-scale AI distributed inference or training systems, including performance modeling and capacity planning for multi rack deployments. Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are: 152,000 USD – 241,500 USD for Level 3; and 184,000 USD – 287,500 USD for Level 4. You will also be eligible for equity and benefits. Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 3, 2026. This posting is for an existing vacancy. NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes. NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law. Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: ML Engineer (MSc. or PhD)
jobs.jd: Senior ML Engineer (MSc. or PhD) Pay: $60–$120/hour Location: Global, fully remote Job Type: Contractor (~15 hours per week) Schedule: Flexible—you choose the hours and days you work, including weekends if desired We are looking for highly skilled Machine Learning Experts to contribute to an AI training project involving model development, training and inference systems, numerical computing, performance optimization, and Python. The work involves creating, solving, reviewing, and validating challenging machine-learning engineering tasks. A representative task may require implementing or modifying a model, constructing a reproducible training or inference workflow, optimizing memory or throughput, debugging numerical or system-level failures, and verifying that the resulting implementation satisfies objective correctness and performance requirements. This is a very coding heavy role. Candidates but have experience using coding agents with python in their workflow. What You’ll Work On Develop and validate machine-learning models, training pipelines, inference systems, and supporting infrastructure. Implement model components, data pipelines, evaluation systems, and numerical methods. Build reproducible programmatic workflows using Python and command-line tools. Required Qualifications A master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or a closely related quantitative discipline. Strong professional or research experience in machine learning. Practical proficiency with Python and coding agents. Equivalent tools may also be considered when the candidate demonstrates directly relevant depth. Experience at a well-established technology company, AI laboratory, research organization, or other recognized engineering environment is strongly preferred. Exceptional open-source or academic experience may also qualify. Process Apply to the role and complete the screening questions. Complete an AI interview of approximately 30 minutes. Complete the hiring manager review. Compensation Structure Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete each task may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply. Start Timeline & Availability We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts who are ready to begin immediately. If selected, you will be expected to start your first task within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding. Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist (AI, ML, Pyspark, SQL)
jobs.jd: Our Purpose Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. Title and Summary Senior Data Scientist (AI, ML, Pyspark, SQL) Overview The Business & Market Insights (B&MI) team within Mastercard's Services division creates products that help customers including financial institutions and merchants understand their customers and the market better. The B&MI Data Science team uses data from Mastercard transactions and other sources to build models and solutions that are needed for these products, at a globally scalable level across the different customer lifecycle stages. This role is for a Data Scientist that will work across Product, Client Services & Delivery, Data & Engineering and the broader teams, to deliver truly differentiated products driven by analytics & AI, leveraging rich data resources, AI platform capabilities and near real-time execution. We are developing multiple new products and capabilities using analytics & AI, and this role is central in that vision, from concept, technical design to market release and optimization. This role is positioned to drive new ideas forward by combining creative thought leadership with innovation and industry best practices. By entering in the early phase of a truly transformative and impactful strategic initiative, the experience is certain to be rewarding. This role requires the successful candidate to have the following: - 5-9 years of overall career experience in Data Science function supporting Products - Design, develop, and productionize machine learning and data science solutions that solve complex business problems within BMI. - Develop traditional ML solutions covering feature engineering, model training, validation, evaluation, and deployment. - Perform exploratory data analysis and translate complex datasets into actionable insights. - Optimize data pipelines and ML workflows for performance, scalability, maintainability, and reliability. - Develop robust and reusable Python components following sound software-engineering practices. - Use PySpark to process, transform, and analyze large datasets efficiently in distributed environments. - Write advanced, optimized SQL for data extraction, transformation, feature development, and analytical workloads. - Apply appropriate controls for data privacy, security, responsible AI, monitoring, and explainability. Good to have: - Understanding of building Generative AI applications using Python and modern GenAI frameworks. The successful candidate’s primary responsibilities will be to: - Drive the evolution of Business & Market Insights products by applying Data Science and Artificial Intelligence to create models, tools and capabilities - Participate in the exploration, application and development of data science for product development - Participate in identification and evaluation of AI/ML techniques and tools to deliver models and analytics for product development - Continuously innovate and determine new data science approaches & technologies to solve business problems and generate business insights & recommendations - Partner with roles across the organization including product, engineering, and sales to determine the highest priority data science problems to solve in a customer-centric framework - Evaluate trade-offs between many possible analytics solutions to a problem, taking into account performance, usability, technical feasibility, timelines, and differing stakeholder opinions to make a decision - Break large solutions into smaller, releasable milestones to collect data and feedback from product managers, clients and other stakeholders - Evangelize releases to users, incorporating feedback, and tracking usage to inform future development - Work with small, cross-functional teams to define vision, establish team culture and processes - Consistently focus on key drivers of organization value and prioritize operational activities accordingly - Identify and act upon product improvement opportunities - Provide technical leadership of junior colleagues as a senior member of the data science team, through technical and non-technical mentoring Corporate Security Responsibility All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices; Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

jobs.title: Expert Data Scientist, Fraud Risk Detection
jobs.jd: Overview Experian's Fraud Analytics & Commercialization operates across four main functions. These include client engagement analytics, scalable and custom analytics for financial institutions, fraud analytics consulting, and solution integrity and enablement for production-ready platforms. We're looking for a motivated Data Scientist to help build fraud detection models and features that identify high-risk activity while minimizing friction for legitimate customers. Core skills for this role include an eagerness to collaborate, and empathy. You will will dig into surprising signals in the data and to learn how that insight becomes a deployed model. You will help investigate the latest fraud patterns, build features, and train and evaluate machine learning models. You will work with senior data scientists and engineers starting with problem definition through feature engineering, experimentation, and deployment. You will be a developing programmer, ready to translate theoretical principles into production-ready solutions. We continue to sharpen through research and the engineering that turns those findings into tools and systems built for commercialization. This is a remote role and you will report into the Sr. Manager of Fraud Analytics. What you'll do Investigate large datasets, including exploratory analysis and fraud label development, to identify latest fraud patterns, attack methods, and behavioral signals. Translate ambiguous fraud and risk problems into clear hypotheses, analytical plans, model requirements, and measurable success criteria. Develop machine learning models for fraud detection across account opening, account takeover, and identity risk. Evaluate models using metrics like ROC/AUC/KS/Gini, precision/recall, fraud capture rate, false-positive rate, customer friction, and fraud losses prevented. Develop and validate predictive features using identity, transactional, consumer credit history, device, behavioral, temporal, velocity, network, and third-party data. Write clean, efficient, well-tested Python and PySpark code, and collaborate with teams to bring models and features into batch, retro, or real-time decisioning environments. Monitor feature quality, model performance, population changes, and fraud-pattern drift Design and present analyses for model behavior, tradeoffs, risks, and recommendations Follow appropriate standards for data privacy, model documentation, explainability, validation, and governance. Qualifications At least 5 years of experience in data science, machine learning, statistical modeling, or a related quantitative field Bachelor's or advanced degree in computer science, statistics, engineering, data science, or another quantitative discipline Direct experience developing fraud-detection, identity-risk, credit-risk, financial-crime, or other adversarial risk models. Demonstrated experience creating meaningful fraud features Proficiency in Python and PySpark, with experience writing modular and tested code for large datasets and distributed or cloud data systems. Experience using common data science and machine-learning tools such as pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow, or comparable technologies. Knowledge of supervised learning, model evaluation, feature selection, statistical inference, experimentation, and model calibration. Experience navigating challenges common to fraud modeling, including class imbalance, delayed or incomplete labels, changing attack patterns, and model drift. Experience moving models beyond experimentation and into production, either directly or in close partnership with engineering teams. #LI-Remote Benefits/Perks: Great compensation package and bonus plan Core benefits including medical, dental, vision, and matching 401K Flexible work environment, ability to work remote, hybrid or in-office Flexible time off including volunteer time off, vacation, sick and 12-paid holidays Explore all our exciting benefits here: https://yourexperianbenefits.com/cand-index.html Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. Experian's people first, inclusive and purpose-driven culture is multi award-winning. We have won World's Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Fortune Global Top 25), and Great Place To Work™ in 26 countries to name a few. Experian's recruitment process is conducted only through authorised channels. Recruitment communications will only be sent from an @ experian.com email address. Experian will never ask candidates to make any payment as part of a recruitment process. Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several U.S. geographic markets. Within this range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors such as job-related skills, experience, and education. You will be eligible for a variable pay opportunity and a comprehensive benefits package. Experian is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer for all groups protected under applicable federal, state and local law, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know at the earliest opportunity.

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.jd: We are looking for a Data Scientist who thrives on creating value, not just building models. This role sits within the Asia Intelligence team, a pragmatic, product-minded group focused on shipping data and AI solutions that make an impact today. You will work closely with engineers, analysts, and stakeholders across Ubisoft to design, build, and evolve AI-powered products that are already in production and growing in ambition. Success in this role is defined by your ability to deliver alongside your team. We care about shipped outcomes, not just experimentation. If you are energised by moving quickly, doing your work end-to-end, and seeing real players affected by what you build then this is the role for you. WHAT YOU WILL DO Your core responsibilities: Design, build, and maintain machine learning models and AI products that are deployed in production and create measurable value for players and the business Contribute to personalisation and decisioning systems - including recommendation engines, segmentation models, propensity scoring, and Next Best Action frameworks - that directly influence player retention and engagement Support the development of AI agent architectures and automation workflows that extend the team’s capacity to deliver intelligence at scale Translate complex stakeholder needs into well-scoped, pragmatic solutions, balancing model sophistication with delivery speed and operational sustainability Collaborate closely with data analysts, data engineers, and product stakeholders to ensure models are integrated, understood, and acted upon In six months: You will have developed a strong working knowledge of our data infrastructure, player behaviour data, and live operations context across active titles You will have familiarised yourself with our suite of ML models spanning forecasting, propensity modelling, and player decisioning, and made meaningful contributions to at least one You will have expanded our AI/ML programme to cover additional player engagement scenarios and franchises, including personalisation and player decisioning capabilities You will have built trusted working relationships with key stakeholders, understanding their needs and how data science can serve them In twelve months: You will be a core contributor to the evolution of our personalisation and player engagement capabilities, including our Next Best Action engine and propensity modelling programme You will have helped shape the roadmap for new AI product opportunities, drawing on a clear view of where ML and agent-based approaches can generate near-term value for the business Essential: At least 3 years’ experience in an applied Data Science or ML role, with a track record of shipping models or AI products into production Demonstrated ability to deliver measurable outcomes through applied ML: your work has made it into the hands of end users, not just into a notebook Strong collaborative instincts: you understand that impact comes from working well with others, not from working alone Pragmatic problem-solver who can scope work appropriately, move fast where needed, and know when good enough beats perfect Comfortable working across disciplines, from game designers and producers to analysts and engineers, with strong communication skills to match Desired: Hands-on experience building personalisation engines, recommendation systems, or player decisioning frameworks Work experience with marketing decisioning platforms such as Adobe Marketing Cloud, Salesforce, Pega, Braze, or similar Experience designing or contributing to AI agent architectures and agentic workflows An interest in games, entertainment, or consumer-facing digital products where player or user behaviour is central to the work TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS Essential: Strong Python skills, including experience writing production-grade code beyond notebook prototypes Solid SQL skills for data exploration, feature engineering, and pipeline work Hands-on experience with ML frameworks such as scikit-learn, LightGBM, PyTorch, or Spark ML Expert-level proficiency in Databricks and/or Snowflake, with experience deploying and managing models in a cloud data platform environment Version control proficiency (git) and familiarity with collaborative development workflows Desired: Experience with MLflow, Delta Lake, or similar tools for model tracking and data management in Databricks environments Familiarity with Snowflake Cortex or Databricks Genie for AI-assisted analytics Experience building or integrating LLM-based agents or tool-use frameworks Familiarity with API development and the deployment of model-serving endpoints We are working to enrich players’ lives through unique and memorable gaming experiences and by improving the positive impacts of our games. To get there, we are creating a safer, more inclusive work environment, we are giving back to the communities where Ubisoft operates by working with local non-profit partners and by working to reduce the environmental impact of our business. We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age or disability status. Come on board and experience #LifeAtUbi for yourself, we are always on the lookout for talents who thrive in bringing their A-game to work. If this sounds like you, shoot us your resume, portfolio, and anything else to show that you’re serious about fun!

jobs.title: Data Scientist - H/F/NB
jobs.jd: En nous rejoignant sur ce poste, vous intégrerez une équipe multidisciplinaire (data, programmation, game & narrative design, animation, etc.), guidée par une question simple et ambitieuse : parmi toutes les possibilités offertes par l’IA générative, lesquelles sont réellement intéressantes et fun pour le gameplay ? L’équipe a pour mission de tester de nouvelles expériences auprès de joueurs et joueuses, et d’équiper les créateur·rices pour imaginer des interactions plus dynamiques, immersives et surprenantes — jusqu’à faire émerger des features impossibles à réaliser autrement. Son quotidien s’inscrit à la croisée de la R&D, du développement produit, de la création de jeux courts et de la collaboration multi-studios, au service des gameplays de demain. Dans le cadre de ce poste, vous rejoindrez une équipe développant un produit technologique favorisant l'intégration de l’IA au sein des fonctionnalités de nos jeux. Au sein de nos studios de production, vous pourrez apporter vos connaissances en Data Science afin de construire des expériences de jeux uniques. jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist — Data Cloud Acceleration
jobs.jd:
WHO WE ARE 

Zeta Global (NYSE: ZETA) is the AI-Powered Marketing Cloud that leverages advanced artificial intelligence (AI) and trillions of consumer signals to make it easier for marketers to acquire, grow, and retain customers more efficiently. Through the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), our vision is to make sophisticated marketing simple by unifying identity, intelligence, and omnichannel activation into a single platform – powered by one of the industry’s largest proprietary databases and AI. Our enterprise customers across multiple verticals are empowered to personalize experiences with consumers at an individual level across every channel, delivering better results for marketing programs. Zeta was founded in 2007 by David A. Steinberg and John Sculley and is headquartered in New York City with offices around the world. To learn more, go to www.zetaglobal.com.

About the team 

The Data Cloud Acceleration team identifies gaps and opportunities across clients and business units, then moves quickly to deliver practical new capabilities. We often develop and deploy the first version of a model, workflow, dataset, or application in days or weeks, learn from real usage, and improve it iteratively. 

We are business-minded technologists who care more about impact than technical novelty. We use sophisticated methods when the problem requires them and simpler approaches when they will deliver a better result faster. Our work should be predictable, demoable, trusted, reusable, measured, and amplified by AI. 

 

About the role 

The Senior Data Scientist will build models, analyses, and supporting ML components that improve business decisions, intelligence products, and client outcomes. You will independently own defined deliverables—from understanding the requirement and preparing the data through modeling, validation, documentation, and delivery. 

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will work across varied revenue and intelligence initiatives, often in partnership with a Lead Data Scientist, application engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders. The right candidate can move quickly without sacrificing trustworthiness and knows how to balance statistical rigor with the practical needs of the business. 

 

What you’ll do

  • Own model and analysis deliverables. Take a defined business problem and independently deliver a reliable model, analysis component, scoring workflow, or supporting dataset.  

  • Translate business questions into analytical approaches. Ask clarifying questions, understand how the output will be used, and recommend an approach that fits the decision, timeline, and available data.  

  • Build and test models quickly. Develop practical solutions using statistical methods, machine learning, deep learning, or existing models and services where appropriate.  

  • Prepare trustworthy data. Profile, cleanse, join, and validate noisy datasets while checking completeness, freshness, distributions, nulls, duplicates, and match rates.  

  • Create repeatable scoring workflows. Move useful work beyond the notebook by building reusable Python components, batch-scoring processes, APIs, or lightweight services.  

  • Evaluate results responsibly. Establish baselines, select appropriate metrics, perform statistical reasonableness checks, reconcile unexpected results, and clearly document limitations.  

  • Support intelligence products and applications. Work with application and data teams to define the right data ingredients, test hypotheses, and integrate model outputs into usable experiences.  

  • Add operational discipline. Include validation, monitoring, failure handling, refresh expectations, documentation, and a clear usage path in delivered work.  

  • Use AI to improve your own productivity. Apply tools such as Claude, Codex, and similar assistants to accelerate coding, testing, research, debugging, and documentation while independently verifying the results.  

  • Communicate progress early and clearly. Make milestones, assumptions, risks, dependencies, and issues visible rather than waiting until delivery.  

 

What ownership looks like at this level

You are expected to own the deliverable. That means: 

  • Working independently on a well-defined model, workflow, dataset, or component  

  • Producing reliable and repeatable outputs rather than one-time analyses  

  • Adding appropriate validation and basic monitoring  

  • Documenting assumptions, methodology, limitations, and usage  

  • Demonstrating the output and explaining how it supports the business  

  • Raising risks and ambiguity early

jobs.title: Data Scientist, Enterprise Analytics
jobs.jd:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An Overview of this role

As a Data Scientist at GitLab on the Enterprise Analytics team,  you’ll be a trusted analytical partner to Sales, Revenue Operations, and Finance, helping define how we measure go-to-market performance and where we invest to grow. This is a strategic and hands-on role. You’ll apply statistical, experimentation, and machine learning methods to forecast outcomes, explain what drives activation, conversion, expansion, and retention, and size opportunities. You’ll also support the company-level reporting and GTM performance views that executives use to run the business, covering consumption, ARR, and first orders.

What you’ll do

  • Embed yourself with business teams to become a trusted partner supporting insight generation and strategic decision making across GTM.
  • Perform exploratory data analysis to uncover behavioral trends, long-term patterns, and the key drivers and levers behind business performance, and communicate their impact clearly to non-technical audiences.
  • Build and productionize machine learning models - such as propensity, product-qualified lead (PQL) scoring, churn, and expansion models - including training, validation, testing, and feature engineering, using MLOps practices and tooling (CI/CD for ML pipelines, model registries, automated retraining, and monitoring) to move work reliably from notebook to production
  • Design, run, and evaluate growth experiments (A/B tests and quasi-experiments) on onboarding, pricing and packaging, and upgrade flows, and measure their impact on activation, conversion, and retention
  • Build and operationalize agentic workflows for analysis, modeling, and pipeline automation, with evaluation and monitoring that keep agent-generated insights accurate, traceable, and trustworthy.
  • Contribute to GitLab’s Semantic Layer enabling stakeholders and agents to self-serve metrics using trusts and tested sources.
  • Write production-grade Python and SQL that meets internal standards for style, maintainability, and performance in a high-scale database environment; maintain and advocate for these standards through code review

What you’ll bring

  • 3-5 years of professional experience in GTM analytics, data science, or a similar technical role
  • Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business problems into clear, measurable questions and communicate technical concepts effectively to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience with experimentation and causal inference (A/B testing, power analysis, quasi-experimental methods) and with statistical and machine learning methods such as regression, classification, clustering, and survival analysis
  • Deep, hands-on understanding of SQL in cloud data warehouses (like Snowflake SQL), including working with product usage and event data, and in business intelligence tools (Looker, Tableau, Hex, or similar)
  • Experience using Python for statistical modeling, machine learning, and production data science. With hands-on experience in pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, Jupyter, and related libraries such as LightGBM and XGBoost
  • Hands-on experience building agentic workflows with AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, OpenCode, or similar), including connecting agents to the right context, tools, and platforms such as MLflow, and evaluating their output for accuracy and reliability.
  • Experience working in a B2C company working with motions and metrics, including Consumption, CRR, ARR, and Churn & Contraction
  • Self-motivated and self-managing, with strong organizational skills
  • Ability to use GitLab and to thrive in a fully remote organization

About the Team

The Enterprise Analytics team builds the trusted data products and insights behind GitLab’s Company wide sales, revenue, and finance reporting. We work across the business on metrics including First Orders, pipeline, CRR, ARR, and other key indicators, helping leaders make informed decisions and teams understand how their work contributes to GitLab’s growth.

The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer 2
jobs.jd:
Who we are 

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! 

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings. 
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Machine Learning Engineer, Customer Memory.

About the job

This position is needed to build and scale the pipelines that turn raw conversation data into structured, searchable customer memory, and the evaluation systems that keep that memory accurate as the product evolves.

You'll join the Conversation Memory team, which builds the memory layer behind Twilio's Conversational AI platform: the systems that extract what matters from millions of conversations, resolve it to the right customer, and retrieve it in milliseconds when an agent needs it. Memory that is wrong, stale, or crossed between customers is worse than no memory at all, so quality measurement is a first-class part of the work.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Build the extraction pipeline that turns raw data into structured memory, tuning the LLM prompts and schemas that decide what an AI agent remembers about a customer and what it forgets.
  • Own the retrieval path that answers "what do we know about this person?" in milliseconds, working with embeddings, vector search, and ranking
  • Contribute to the eval systems that tell us whether memory is actually getting better, turning a fuzzy question of quality into benchmarks and regression gates that run before every change ships.
  • Diagnose production issues across the ingestion, extraction, and indexing path using logs, metrics, and traces.
  • Partner with Product and ML teams to translate customer problems into system changes and evaluation criteria.

Qualifications 

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Required:

  • Experience building backend services, and a demonstrated ability to pick up new languages, frameworks, and tools as the problem demands.
  • A curious approach to service management: ability to investigate how systems actually behave in production, and desire to continuously learn how to operate them with rigor and accountability.
  • Experience building or working with evaluation/quality-measurement systems, such as regression detection or quality metrics, or the desire to learn.
  • Solid grounding in observability practices: structured logging, metrics, and using them to debug distributed systems in production.
  • Fluency with AI-assisted dev tools (e.g. agents for code generation, review, debugging), applied with deliberate direction and critical thinking.

Desired:

  • Experience with Go and/or Python.
  • Experience with event-streaming systems (e.g. Kafka).
  • Experience building LLM-backed products.
  • Practical experience applying ML, e.g. building, evaluating, or productionizing models.

Location

  • This role will be remote, but is not eligible to be hired in San Francisco, CA, Oakland, CA, San Jose, CA, or the surrounding areas.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Compensation

*Please note the salary range information provided applies only to candidates residing in California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State due to local requirements. Compensation for candidates in other locations will be discussed during the hiring process. Please note that hiring for this role is not restricted to the locations listed above.

jobs.title: Data Scientist, Cloud Distribution & Growth
jobs.jd: About the Team Cloud service providers give developers a way to use OpenAI models in the environments where they already build and run software. Our team works with Go-to-Market (GTM), Product, Engineering, and Finance to understand which customers we can reach through these providers and what helps them grow from a first API call to a production workload. About the Role In your first few months, you’ll identify a customer segment or workload where OpenAI can grow, recommend an investment to GTM, Product, and Engineering, and define how we’ll know whether it brought new usage to OpenAI. Your first priority will be to explain what drives usage and revenue across providers. You’ll use that understanding to help GTM decide which customers and workloads to invest in and to build forecasts the team can plan against. A customer might sign a substantial cloud commitment and send very little traffic. You can sit down with the account team, trace the customer’s first requests, and work out whether they need help launching, access to a different model, or more capacity. When you see the same opportunity across customers, your work can change where OpenAI invests. In This Role, You Will: - Build a reliable view of the business from provider usage reports, billing records, and API logs. Show how new workloads, expansion, changes in price, and shifts in model mix contribute to growth. - Estimate how much demand cloud distribution adds to OpenAI. Trace customer activity across channels to distinguish new use cases from traffic that moved from the direct API. - Identify where customers are ready to scale. Combine what account teams hear with evidence on request failures, latency, and model availability. Work with Product and Engineering on a change and measure what happens to usage. - Shape growth plans with GTM and Finance. Estimate what existing workloads and upcoming launches can contribute by year end, test the assumptions that matter most, and recommend where to focus with each provider. - Own the consumption forecast. Compare forecasts with actual usage over the same period, explain the biggest misses, and use what you learn to improve the next forecast. You Might Thrive in This Role If You: - Like questions that take you from a conversation with an account team to a query about a single API request. You’re curious about why a customer’s behavior differs from what the numbers first suggest. - Are comfortable making a recommendation while some questions are still open. You can tell a sales leader where you’d invest and explain to an engineer what evidence would change your mind. Qualifications - Experience independently leading data science work on a product, growth, or commercial question that changed a business decision. - Strong SQL and Python skills. You can join incomplete datasets, choose the right unit of analysis, and validate an aggregate result against individual customers or workloads. - Experience using cohorts, experiments, or observational comparisons to assess what drove a change. You can explain how customer selection affects the conclusion and evaluate a forecast against a simple baseline. Preferred Qualifications - Experience with API platforms, cloud marketplaces, enterprise GTM, or a usage-based business. - Experience connecting service reliability or capacity to customer adoption, or using demand forecasts to guide a commercial or infrastructure investment. jobs.title: Lead Data Scientist (AI/ML, Python, Langchain, GenAI, Pyspark, SQL)
jobs.jd: Our Purpose Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. Title and Summary Lead Data Scientist (AI/ML, Python, Langchain, GenAI, Pyspark, SQL) Lead, Data Scientist • Our Purpose The Business & Market Insights (B&MI) team within Mastercard's Services division creates products that help customers including financial institutions and merchants understand their customers and the market better. The B&MI Data Science team uses data from Mastercard transactions and other sources to build models and solutions that are needed for these products, at a globally scalable level across the different customer lifecycle stages. This role is for a Data Scientist that will work across Product, Client Services & Delivery, Data & Engineering and the broader teams, to deliver truly differentiated products driven by analytics & AI, leveraging rich data resources, AI platform capabilities and near real-time execution. We are developing multiple new products and capabilities using analytics & AI, and this role is central in that vision, from concept, technical design to market release and optimization. This role is positioned to drive new ideas forward by combining creative thought leadership with innovation and industry best practices. By entering in the early phase of a truly transformative and impactful strategic initiative, the experience is certain to be rewarding. This role requires the successful candidate to have the following: - 8-12 years of overall career experience in Data Science function supporting Products - Design, develop, and productionize machine learning and data science solutions that solve complex business problems within BMI. - Develop traditional ML solutions covering feature engineering, model training, validation, evaluation, and deployment. - Perform exploratory data analysis and translate complex datasets into actionable insights. - Build Generative AI applications using Python and modern GenAI frameworks, particularly LangChain and LangGraph. - Optimize data pipelines and ML/GenAI workflows for performance, scalability, maintainability, and reliability. - Evaluate GenAI solutions for answer quality, groundedness, reliability, latency, and cost, rather than relying solely on prototype-level demonstrations. - Develop robust and reusable Python components following sound software-engineering practices. - Use PySpark to process, transform, and analyze large datasets efficiently in distributed environments. - Write advanced, optimized SQL for data extraction, transformation, feature development, and analytical workloads. - Collaborate with product managers, AI engineers, software engineers, and other data scientists to translate business requirements into technical solutions. - Apply appropriate controls for data privacy, security, responsible AI, monitoring, and explainability. - Conduct code reviews, establish reusable technical patterns, and mentor less-experienced data scientists. The successful candidate’s primary responsibilities will be to: - Drive the evolution of B&MI products with an impact focused on data science and engineering - Participate in the exploration, application and development of data science for product development - Participate in identification and evaluation of AI/ML techniques and tools to deliver models and analytics for product development - Continuously innovate and determine new data science approaches & technologies to solve business problems and generate business insights & recommendations - Partner with roles across the organization including product, engineering, and sales to determine the highest priority data science problems to solve in a customer-centric framework - Evaluate trade-offs between many possible analytics solutions to a problem, taking into account performance, usability, technical feasibility, timelines, and differing stakeholder opinions to make a decision - Break large solutions into smaller, releasable milestones to collect data and feedback from product managers, clients and other stakeholders - Evangelize releases to users, incorporating feedback, and tracking usage to inform future development - Work with small, cross-functional teams to define vision, establish team culture and processes - Consistently focus on key drivers of organization value and prioritize operational activities accordingly - Identify and act upon product improvement opportunities - Provide technical leadership of junior colleagues as a senior member of the data science team, through technical and non-technical mentoring Corporate Security Responsibility All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices; Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.jd: About Us: Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights. Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi. About the role: We’re looking for a Senior AI Engineer to build and run the agents at the heart of Tebi OS. You’ll design, ship, evaluate and scale our Product Agents, along with the data pipelines, tools and infrastructure that make them reliable in production. The ideal candidate started in data or ML engineering and has since moved into AI engineering, building LLM-powered agents for real users. You enjoy turning messy financial and operational data into context an agent can reason over and act on with confidence and you are passionate about solving product challenges through AI. You’ll work closely with product and engineering to put intelligence into the hands of hospitality teams. That could be an agent that answers questions about a restaurant’s finances in real time, one that automates repetitive back-office tasks, or internal tools that help us move faster. What you’ll do: Design, build and operate production agents: orchestration, tool and function calling, memory, multi-step reasoning, and integration with Tebi’s backend services Build the data foundations agents rely on, including real-time and batch pipelines over financial and operational data, retrieval layers, and well-modeled datasets agents can query safely and accurately Turn APIs and internal services into well-defined agent tools, and own the contracts between agents and the rest of the platform Set up evaluation for agent behavior: offline eval sets, LLM-as-judge and human review, regression testing on prompt and model changes, and feedback loops that improve agents over time Own observability for agents in production by tracing sessions, tool calls and model calls, and tracking latency, cost, error rates and quality Work with product teams to find where agents can meaningfully improve the customer experience or internal workflows, and say clearly where they can’t Make sure agents handle data securely and responsibly, with sensible guardrails, access controls, and protection against prompt injection and data leakage What you’ll bring: 7+ years in software engineering, with a solid base in data or ML engineering Hands-on experience building and shipping LLM agents to production, not just prototypes. You’ve dealt with flaky tool calls, runaway loops, hallucinated arguments and token budgets, and you have opinions on how to handle them. Strong data modeling and data warehousing fundamentals, plus experience with ingestion, transformation and data quality Strong SQL, and experience with pipeline tools (e.g. Airflow, dbt) and analytical or cloud data platforms (e.g. ClickHouse, BigQuery, Snowflake) Experience evaluating and monitoring LLM systems, and an understanding of the full lifecycle from experiment to deployment to ongoing improvement Backend engineering skills: you’re comfortable building the API endpoint that exposes an agent’s output to the frontend, or the service an agent calls as a tool Clear communication, including the ability to explain trade-offs in latency, cost, accuracy and complexity to product partners A product mindset. You care about how your work lands with users, and you’re keen to meet customers face to face to understand their needs. This probably isn't the role for you if you have been working with AI agents to improve your day to day working flows but you haven’t built an Agent in the production. People who succeed at Tebi are independent, curious and passionate about hospitality. If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Learn more about how we work from our Recipe here: https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers . Benefits: Start-up Equity Competitive Salary Lunch Provided in Office Team building events Unlimited time off What is Restaurant Software? Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it. From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy. How we use AI at Tebi We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed. At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call.
